Background changes to a forest of bare trees, his face turns angry/frowning, text 'HACKING AWAY AT WOOD'. He stays in this close-up with only eye/face shifts for a long time. Wipe to a small figure beside a dark road with an orange sun ('WEEKS ON THE ROAD'). Close-up surprised face pointing right ('MAGIC SURGING IN HIS CHEST', 'PUSHING AGAINST HIS CONTROL'), then a large key icon beside him.

Y.whatHappened: Identical opening as X (scale, marionette, mirror 'A FOOT SOLDIER', close-up worried face). Then the character shrinks and stands with an axe next to a wooden stump on a base. He raises the axe overhead, swings down; a spark/impact flash appears where the axe hits the stump top (about 1377-1380); the stump splits into two halves forming a V, which spread wider and lie on the base. He lowers the axe and holds it at his side, then the shot repeats the same standing pose with the broken stump. Cut to close-up surprised face pointing, then the same key/magic sequence presumably follows.
Y.why: He swings the axe and strikes the stump; the impact (spark at 1377/1380) is immediately followed by the stump splitting (1400).
Y.changedAfterwards: The stump stays split in two halves (V/open shape, halves lying flatter) in frames 1400-1415, 1440-1700 (it appears lying open in 1440, 1485, 1500, 1530, 1600, 1620, 1665, 1700, 1710, 1755). He holds the axe vertically at his side. In frame 1575 and 1430 the stump looks faded/absent (flicker or fade).

X.whatHappened: Black start. A row of dark-clad people (two bright in front, shadowy others behind) in an office with an orbit/atom diagram on a board. Split screen: a woman in black with ponytail on white side and a bearded man in orange on an orange side, a small balance scale between them. Then both in an office; she raises her arm and holds out a black door-like panel that turns orange (frames 1170-1200 onward, held out through ~1305). Orange room with her black silhouette pointing, a cracked orange panel at the left, text 'EMOTIONAL FRICTION'. Her big black silhouette head in the foreground while the orange man stands with a maze drawing next to him. Then she stands small in an office next to a scale tilting; she closes her eyes, the scene dissolves, a man with glasses and beard in black appears, with an orange triangle-in-circle-in-rounded-square icon rotating beside him through frames 1376-2025... Actually the icon rotates slowly for a long period. Last: close-up of the ponytail woman with a clock and cracks at left, then a worried face with text 'NOT WHAT IT SEEMS' struck through.
X.why: Mostly unclear; the scale tilting (1620-1800) changes slightly; the panel color change is not caused by anything visible. Scene changes are cuts/wipes.
X.changedAfterwards: Scale remains tilted to the right/orange side in 1665-1800 and sinks/tips to off-position at 1890-1935. The orange panel stays held out in 1260-1305 frames. The crack remains on the left panel from 1342-1412 (shrinking out of frame).

Y.whatHappened: Same opening (office crowd, split screen woman and orange man with scale). Then the woman runs through a city street (silhouette of buildings, lamp-post), worried. Cut to orange room with her black silhouette pointing, cracked panel at left, text 'EMOTIONAL FRICTION'. Then close-up silhouette with the orange man and a maze. Then she runs again through the street, face worried. She stops, holds a small orange sneaker on a T-shaped stand/pedestal in her hand (frames ~1342-1385), pulls it to her chest, then the sneaker is gone from her hand and a grey sneaker appears on the ground in front of her. She holds out her arm, then a small grey pebble leaves her hand and arcs in a long dotted path to the upper right. Then she runs again with a smile. Final close-up: clock with cracks at left, then worried face with 'NOT WHAT IT SEEMS' struck through.
Y.why: Unclear - the held orange sneaker moves to her chest, then a grey sneaker is on the ground; no visible link between those. The pebble is thrown by her arm swing.
Y.changedAfterwards: A dark sneaker lies on the ground to the right of her in frames 1400-1485 (flickering between grey and dark at 1395-1465); the hand has no sneaker afterwards. After the throw (1470-1485) the dotted arc/pebble goes off to the upper right and she is empty-handed. Subsequent run scenes (1500-1540) show no sneaker.

Her arm remains extended. Then a new shot: the left figure stands alone and a dark three-headed dog (Cerberus) stands to the right with the red ball at its feet (350-540).

In 350-540 the red ball lies on the ground by the Cerberus figure, which is a different composition; the right figure and the horned figure are no longer present, the other figure stands alone at left.
